from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date


@dataclass
class Address:
    name: str
    line1: str
    city: str
    postcode: str
    country: str                   # ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "US", "GB"
    line2: str = ""
    region: str = ""               # state / county


@dataclass
class Customer:
    id: str
    email: str
    name: str
    addresses: list[Address] = field(default_factory=list)
    marketing_opt_in: bool = False
    tier: str = "standard"         # standard | silver | gold
    joined: date | None = None
    tags: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)

    @property
    def default_address(self) -> Address | None:
        return self.addresses[0] if self.addresses else None

    @property
    def first_name(self) -> str:
        return self.name.split()[0] if self.name.strip() else ""

"""Newsletter sends. Only customers who opted in receive marketing email."""
from shopkit.customers.models import Customer
from shopkit.marketing.campaigns import Campaign
from shopkit.notifications.templates import render_template
from shopkit.utils.collections import chunked

BATCH_SIZE = 500          # provider limit per API call

BODY = "Hi {{ first_name }},\n\n{{ intro }}\n\nShop now: {{ link }}\n\nUnsubscribe: {{ unsubscribe }}"


def recipients(customers: list[Customer]) -> list[Customer]:
    return [c for c in customers if c.marketing_opt_in]


def render_for(customer: Customer, campaign: Campaign, intro: str) -> str:
    return render_template(BODY, {"first_name": customer.first_name or "there", "intro": intro,
                                  "link": campaign.link(),
                                  "unsubscribe": f"https://shop.example/unsubscribe/{customer.id}"})


def batches(customers: list[Customer]) -> list[list[str]]:
    return [[c.email for c in batch] for batch in chunked(recipients(customers), BATCH_SIZE)]

"""Outgoing email. Messages are queued; a worker hands them to the mail provider."""
from dataclasses import dataclass

from shopkit.config import SETTINGS
from shopkit.notifications.templates import TEMPLATES, render_template
from shopkit.utils.validation import is_valid_email


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Email:
    to: str
    subject: str
    body: str
    reply_to: str = SETTINGS.support_email


class Outbox:
    def __init__(self):
        self.queued: list[Email] = []

    def send(self, to: str, template: str, **values) -> Email:
        if not is_valid_email(to):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid recipient {to!r}")
        subject_t, body_t = TEMPLATES[template]
        email = Email(to, render_template(subject_t, values), render_template(body_t, values))
        self.queued.append(email)
        return email

    def drain(self) -> list[Email]:
        out, self.queued = self.queued, []
        return out

"""Marketing campaigns: landing pages and UTM-tagged links for newsletters and ads."""
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from urllib.parse import urlencode

STOREFRONT = "https://shop.example"


def campaign_handle(name: str) -> str:
    """Short handle used as utm_campaign: lowercase, words joined by underscores, max 30 chars.
    "Black Friday 2026!" -> "black_friday_2026"."""
    return "_".join(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", name.lower()))[:30]


@dataclass
class Campaign:
    name: str
    starts: date
    ends: date
    channel: str = "email"                 # email | social | search
    skus: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def handle(self) -> str:
        return campaign_handle(self.name)

    def link(self, path: str = "/") -> str:
        query = urlencode({"utm_source": self.channel, "utm_medium": self.channel,
                           "utm_campaign": self.handle})
        return f"{STOREFRONT}{path}?{query}"

    def running(self, today: date) -> bool:
        return self.starts <= today <= self.ends
